name: London forecast (Open-Meteo)
gives: Forecast for London from Open-Meteo: hourly temperature, chance and amount of rain, wind and weather code for 3 days, each day's lowest and highest temperature, and every forecast we served kept for 14 days. A model forecast for a grid point, not a warning.

terms.summary: Used under Open-Meteo's free non-commercial terms because data.promptugal.news is free and carries no subscriptions or adverts (Dinis, 18 Nov 2026). Sites that charge must not reuse it without a paid plan; that line is still being settled. Data CC BY 4.0: credit Open-Meteo (link to https://open-meteo.com/) and the models' providers, and say if changed. Not reviewed by a person.
